description: Search public Medium posts, people, publications, topics, or lists with native GraphQL fields, internal pagination, and a visible DOM fallback.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results, strict positive integer from 1 to 100

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Search result type: posts, people, publications, topics, or lists

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Standard sort: default, latest, or popular; Medium currently reports non-default values in ignoredParams

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Standard time range: all, day, week, month, or year; Medium currently reports non-all values in ignoredParams
